purpose: WP0-WP1 preparation for the eight-week plan; independent robot-domain evaluation
camera_scope: one fixed camera for core; one explicitly defined reobserve action

dev.role: model selection and failure analysis; calibration cross-validation

calibration.role: final calibrator and thresholds after model freeze

family_rule.unit: scene-query family, with a parent scene lineage ID
family_rule.assignment: pre-register parent-scene namespace and deterministic seed manifest before capture

inference_allowlist: camera calibration only if explicitly required by downstream projection
legacy_data_policy: Existing Gazebo raw dataset is absent in datasets root. Restore and verify lineage or recapture; legacy cache/checkpoint integrity does not establish independent data availability.
ood_policy: Choose one axis before capture. Pear appears in RefSpatial adaptation pool; do not claim unseen semantic category for pear. Unseen mesh requires explicit asset lineage.
must_resolve_before_capture_lock: metric relation margins and ambiguity rules
reobserve budget and policy development scenes
